name: publicWeb_startDirectMessage
description: The public web's door to HC6.hcapp_startDirectMessage (direct messages E9.F1.S7/S18/S19, 'Message <name>'). A thin 'wrap for writes' wrapper: it EXECs hcapp_startDirectMessage with the browser's own device credentials and adds no checks of its own, so the web and the app cannot drift. Auth, permission gate and every rule live in hcapp_startDirectMessage (the token must be signed for 'hcapp_startDirectMessage', because the inner SP validates under its own name). Reachable only through PublicWebAdminApi behind HC_INTERNAL_SECRET. Returns hcapp_startDirectMessage's rowsets unchanged. PublicWebAdminApi strips the API-only rowsets 2+ before the reply, so the web sees rowsets 0-1.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: The calling browser's HC.Device id (the browser is a registered device). No SQL default.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Device-bound token signed for 'hcapp_startDirectMessage' (the inner SP validates it under its own name via HC6.ValidateAppAuth). No SQL default.

parameters.name: targetPublicHasherId
parameters.description: The hasher to message, by public id. Wins when both ids are given. Passed straight to hcapp_startDirectMessage.

rowsets.description: From hcapp_startDirectMessage: Auth failure (ValidateAppAuth) returns this detail rowset ALONE, with no envelope. The SP's own refusals return {success:0, errorCode, errorType} at index 0 then this detail at index 1: 2002 target not found / removed / self (errorType 2), 2003 unhandled (5). No debugMessage column.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: From hcapp_startDirectMessage: Index 0 on 2002 and 2003, followed by the detail at index 1.

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: From hcapp_startDirectMessage: On success: {success = 1, errorMessage = NULL}.

rowsets.name: Result

columns.name: ThreadId
columns.description: UPPER-case thread id when Outcome = 'open', else NULL. Clients lowercase on arrival.

columns.name: OtherPublicHasherId
columns.description: UPPER(CAST(Hasher.PublicHasherId AS NVARCHAR(40))) of the target.

rowsets.description: From hcapp_startDirectMessage: On success: the outcome and the other party.

rowsets.name: PushDetail
rowsets.description: From hcapp_startDirectMessage: API-only, stripped: present only when this call created a NEW request (@newRequest = 1).

rowsets.name: Recipients
rowsets.description: From hcapp_startDirectMessage: API-only, stripped, new request only: the target's devices with removed = 0, an FcmToken, LastLogin within 180 days and BuildNumber >= HC6.MinBuildForDmPush().

columns.name: BadgeTotal
columns.description: HC6.UserUnreadChatTotal for the icon badge; NULL on builds below HC6.MinBuildForIconBadge().

sideEffects: New request (no row either way, target friends-only): INSERT HC.HasherFriendMap (UserId = caller, Friend_UserId = target, FriendSince NULL).

Outcome 'open': MERGE WITH (HOLDLOCK) both direction rows of HC.HasherFriendMap — FriendSince = COALESCE(existing, now), ThreadId = existing thread or NEWID(), Removed = 0, updatedAt = now; inserts a missing direction row. HasherFriendMap.ThreadId / Removed come from db/hc6/app/archive/2026-09-29_direct_messages.sql and updatedAt from 2026-09-29_hasher_block.sql (not in the stale table file).
Nothing is written for 'blocked', 'refused', or a silent 'requested' (pending, declined, unfriended, or blocked by the target).
Rowsets 2-3 drive a 'dmRequest' push sent by the API.
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on 2002 and in the CATCH (after ROLLBACK).
PublicWebAdminApi removes rowsets 2+ (PushDetail, Recipients) before replying; the web sends no request push yet (E9.F7.S15 gap).

On an error that escapes the inner SP (or the EXEC itself) the CATCH rolls back, logs 'Unhandled error in publicWeb_startDirectMessage' to HC.ErrorLog (HcVersion '<web>', deviceId) and re-THROWs, so the API returns 500.

codeSmells.detail: @deviceId, @accessToken (line 14-15) have no SQL default. A caller that omits one fails with 'expects parameter' before the SP runs: PublicWebAdminApi's catch logs only a generic exception row and returns 500, and the SP's own graceful checks and error envelope never run.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
